# GitHub Spec Kit integration

GitHub Spec Kit should own the general specification lifecycle. This accelerator adds Fabric-specific discovery, fit assessment, compatibility, review, deployment and operations controls.

Recommended flow:

1. Initialise Spec Kit for GitHub Copilot.
2. Apply `accelerator/constitution.md`.
3. Run Fabric discovery and fit assessment.
4. Use Spec Kit to specify, plan, create tasks, implement and converge.
5. Run Fabric review and production-readiness gates.

Upstream: <https://github.com/github/spec-kit>
